items.limitations: Scoped supplied impact assessment; actual dependency scan is engagement-bounded, not an automatic firm-wide legal opinion.

Exact supplied codes only; a mismatch is a specialist review indicator, never an unlawfulness conclusion.
Checks supplied period continuity/overlap and approvals; does not edit statutory calendars or infer authority permission.
Status is supplied evidence, not government acceptance; no automatic election submission or revocation.
Evidence/cost reconciliation only; no automatic adequate-substance or QFZP conclusion.
No registry lookup or automatic qualifying-income determination.
Per-supplied tax bucket only; no assumption that credits transfer between taxes or authority utilization ledger.
Creates a governed index/draft pack, not a new external sharing room or government disclosure.
Differences are shown separately; equality is not presumed and no legal treatment is inferred.
End date is exclusive. Reviewed weighted-expenditure inputs and simple day-count rate only; no automatic qualifying-asset judgment.
Proposed transfer only; ready-for-use and depreciation dates require approved evidence.
Straight-line component model only; estimate revisions and replacement classification remain reviewed.
Eligibility is an approved input, not inferred from project labels or developer time records.
Approved allocation fractions only; no automatic IAS38/cloud contract classification.
Condition indicators only; no lease schedule is produced before a separate approved identification judgment.
Relative-price allocation with conserved totals; practical expedients and component judgments are approved inputs.
At-market retained-rights model only; off-market adjustments and full IFRS16 subsequent measurement require specialist extension.
Simple approved periodic finance/operating alternatives; no manufacturer/dealer lessor model or implicit-rate valuation.
Lower-of measurement candidate only after supplied approved classification; no automatic eligibility determination.
Reviewed matched shipments only; advances remain separate from revenue and costs.
Supplied booking joins only; no airline settlement connection or automatic gross/net revenue classification.
Rejections are separate follow-up items; no claim approval prediction or live insurer portal.
Authorized pseudonymous student control rows only; no student-system connection or automatic fee/tax policy.
Recipe/stock arithmetic is rules_baseline, not trained anomaly inference; unsupplied stock movements remain a limitation.
Reviewed batch costs only; no automatic ERP costing run or full equivalent-unit model.
Reviewed quantities and deductions only; no independent laboratory or weighbridge authentication.
Deterministic variance ranking against supplied contextual baselines; not a trained model or misconduct finding.
Reviewed attributable expenses; capitalization/deferral of mobilization requires a separate approved policy.
Separates losses from supplied approved recovery; no netting, insurer acceptance claim or autonomous contingent-asset judgment.
Reviewed bucket forecast only; no guaranteed cash outcome or automatic collector/payment scheduling.
No guaranteed cash savings; accounting estimates are kept separate from operational actions.
Rule-based hold recommendation only; no actual order release and no substitution of ML scores for approval.
Two-factor price/volume bridge; unsupported mix/timing/labor attribution remains an explicit residual.
Supplied movement bridge only; no automatic cashflow classification or profit-quality opinion.
Allocation-sensitive ranking only; no claim that allocated margins are independently verified segment results.
Supplied normalized unit prices only; concentration and price indicators are rules, not trained inference.
Transparent scenario arithmetic, not a forecast; nonpositive contribution is reported as no finite break-even.
Simple contractual interest scenario only; no recommendation execution, reinvestment or bank instruction.
Approved supplied DAG blocks actual completion; no discovery of unsupplied ERP close tasks.
Numeric/date/name-mapping checks only; semantic legal translation requires a qualified reviewer.
Hash/reference indicators only; no definitive forgery/authenticity conclusion or forensic signature validation.
Support counts never establish sufficiency; conclusion remains human judgment.
Management completion is not treated as verified remediation; no automatic closure of the original finding.
Provided coverage universe only; risk ordering is rules_baseline and never trained inference by default.

Auditor review workflow only; no independent competence certification or valuation assurance.
Factual draft only; audit opinion and assurance conclusions are explicitly prohibited in the generated conclusion.
Engagement-specific financial diligence definitions only; no investment recommendation or unsupported normalized-earnings assurance.
Draft variation proposal and approval/billing reconciliation only; no client communication or automatic fee entitlement.
